segments.tts: Agenty's Prospect Watch! Who's next? I've got the list.
Gavin McKenna. Toronto won the 2026 lottery with just eight and a half percent odds – and took him first overall!
Luckier than Biscuit making a save!
Number two pick: Ivar Stenberg, from Sweden. Thirty-three points at eighteen – the most in the Swedish league since the Sedin twins.
The Sedins? Back in my day, THEY were the prospects.
Matthew Schaefer: youngest Calder Trophy winner ever – and unanimous!
Twenty-three goals. Tied Brian Leetch's rookie record for a defenseman.
And Macklin Celebrini: one hundred fifteen points at nineteen. A Sharks record!
